items.title: Expedia (EXPE) Stock Trades Down, Here Is Why
items.summary: Shares of online travel agency Expedia (NASDAQ:EXPE) fell 7.2% in the afternoon session after Barron’s Anita Hamilton wrote that Expedia, Booking Holdings, Tripadvisor, and Airbnb were falling because Muse can book flights and places to stay. Expedia was down 5.5%, to $265.60, by midday Tuesday, she reported.
